description: Implementation of SPDY protocol frame serialization and deserialization, including frame building, encoding, and handling of various SPDY frame types such as HEADERS, PUSH_PROMISE, SETTINGS, PING, and others. Contains methods for serializing frames, managing HPACK header encoding, and frame iteration.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for serializing SPDY frames, handling frame encoding and progression.

classes.name: SpdyHeaderFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for SPDY HEADERS frames, manages encoding and continuation frames.

classes.name: SpdyPushPromiseFrameIterator
classes.description: Iterator for SPDY PUSH_PROMISE frames, manages encoding and continuation frames.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameIterator
classes.description: Generic iterator for control frames, serializes a single frame.

classes.name: FrameSerializationVisitor
classes.description: Visitor pattern implementation for serializing various SPDY frame IRs into frames.

classes.name: FlagsSerializationVisitor
classes.description: Visitor pattern implementation for serializing frame flags based on IRs.

classes.name: FrameSerializationVisitorWithOutput
classes.description: Visitor for serializing frames directly into a provided output buffer.

methods.name: SerializeFrame
methods.description: Serializes a given SPDY frame IR into a binary frame, writing to output buffer.

methods.name: SerializeData
methods.description: Serializes a SPDY DATA frame IR into a binary frame.

methods.name: SerializeHeaders
methods.description: Serializes a HEADERS frame IR, including HPACK encoding and continuation handling.

methods.name: GetHpackEncoder
methods.description: Returns the HPACK encoder instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: UpdateHeaderEncoderTableSize
methods.description: Updates the HPACK header table size setting.

methods.name: header_encoder_table_size
methods.description: Returns the current HPACK header table size setting.
